units.source_text: 这天只下了十五六手，不至于要查对的，整个棋局都装在棋手的脑子里，吃饭时也好，睡觉时也好，棋局都会在脑际盘旋。

en.t: Only fifteen or sixteen moves had been played that day, so there was hardly any need to check them; the entire game was lodged in the players' minds, and whether they were eating or sleeping, the position kept turning over in their heads.

units.source_text: 名人却偏要亲手将棋子摆上查对，否则就不能满意。

en.t: Yet the Master insisted on setting out the stones himself and checking the position; otherwise he could not be satisfied.

units.source_text: 许是反映了名人一丝不苟的细致作风，或是表现了名人爱绕弯子的另一面的性格。

en.t: Perhaps this reflected the Master's meticulous, painstaking way of doing things, or perhaps it revealed another side of his character, his fondness for taking the long way around.

units.source_text: 我从老名人这种有趣之处中感到他性格孤僻，并不太幸福。

en.t: In this curious trait of the old Master, I sensed his solitary, eccentric nature, and felt that he was not very happy.
